svg.aria-label: Three panels with the same kind of normative curve and a subject aged 45. Panel A, z-maps: at the chronological age the value is 2.1 SD below the mean. Panel B, NormBrainAGE: the value is most typical at age 59, the brain age, so BrainAGE is plus 14 years. Panel C, BrainLOSS: the mean of a brain part is 2.7 SD below the mean at age 45 but only 1.3 SD below it at the brain age of 59, so BrainLOSS is plus 1.3 and BrainLOSS_age is plus 2.7.
